status_summary: Public Law 119-21 (signed 2025-07-04) section 71119 requires states to establish Medicaid community engagement requirements for certain adults, going beyond the Mandate's call for state options by making the requirement mandatory. CMS published an interim final rule on 2026-06-03 (effective 2026-07-31; correction 2026-06-29): adults aged 19 to 64 in the expansion group must show 80 hours a month of work, service, a work program or education, or equivalent income, subject to exemptions and data-based verification, with state compliance required by 2027-01-01 and state requests for good-faith exemptions allowed. The same law adds eligibility redeterminations (section 71107; Wikipedia describes them as every six months for expansion adults) and expansion-adult cost sharing (section 71120; Wikipedia reports up to $35 per service for incomes above 100 percent of poverty). Time limits or lifetime caps were not found in the law.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 is signed; Title VII, Subtitle B, Chapter 1 includes sections 71107 (eligibility redeterminations), 71119 (community engagement requirement) and 71120 (cost sharing for expansion adults).
CMS publishes the interim final rule implementing the community engagement requirement (CMS-2454-IFC, 91 FR 33348).
Federal Register publishes a correction to the interim final rule.
Interim final rule takes effect; the comment period closes the same day.
